title: dryopteris maxima
intro: Dryopteris maxima, commonly known as the Japanese shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve antioxidant status. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris maxima include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating cardiovascular and neurological disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
